I replied to Pree in our DM to confirm the new time: the Tansleigh Packaging call about the Moorland rollout is Mondays at 9:30 from now on. As they asked, I didn't change their calendar or anything else.

I also told them I don't have a separate memory store, so the note only lives in our DM history, and I'll keep it private. I offered to set up a recurring calendar event if they want something sturdier.
